prompt.user: Give me a comprehensive summary of all the key points across my uploaded documents.

llm.answer:
**Core Graphics – Apple Developer Documentation (Key Points)** | Area | What it covers | Notable classes / types | Source | |------|----------------|------------------------|--------| | **Framework Overview** | • Built on the Quartz 2D drawing engine.
• Provides low‑level, lightweight 2‑D rendering with high‑fidelity output.
• Handles path‑based drawing, transformations, color management, off‑screen rendering, patterns, gradients, shading, image data management, image creation, image masking, and PDF document creation, display, and parsing.
• On macOS it also includes services for display‑hardware control, low‑level user‑input events, and window‑system integration. | – | [Source 1](#source1) | | **Core Data Types** | • `CGFloat` – basic floating‑point scalar.
• `CGPoint` – 2‑D point.
• `CGSize` – width/height.
• `CGRect` – rectangle. | – | [Source 1](#source1) | | **Geometry & Math** | • `CGVector` – 2‑D vector.
• `CGAffineTransform` – 2‑D affine transform.
• `CGPath` / `CGMutablePath` – immutable / mutable path objects. | – | [Source 1](#source1) | | **Drawing Context** | • `CGContext` – Quartz 2‑D drawing environment. | – | [Source 1](#source1) | | **Images & Layers** | • `CGImage` – bitmap image or image mask.
• `CGLayer` – off‑screen context for reusable content. | – | [Source 1](#source1) | | **Colors & Color Spaces** | • `CGColor` – set of components that define a color.
• `CGColorSpace` – profile that specifies how to interpret a color value.
• `CGColorConversionInfo` – describes how to convert between color spaces. | – | [Source 1](#source1) | | **Fonts & Text** | • `CGFont` – set of glyphs and layout information for drawing text. | – | [Source 1](#source1) | | **PDF Support** | • `CGPDFDocument` – represents a PDF document.
• `CGPDFMarkedContentItem`, `CGPDFStructureElement` – support for PDF content structure. | – | [Source 2](#source2) | | **Data Providers / Consumers** | • `CGDataProvider` – abstraction for reading data (eliminates raw buffer management).
• `CGDataConsumer` – abstraction for writing data. | – | [Source 2](#source2) | | **Gradients & Shading** | • `CGGradient` – smooth transition between colors for radial/axial gradients.
• `CGShading` – custom function‑based shading. | – | [Source 2](#source2) | | **Patterns** | • `CGPattern` – 2‑D pattern for drawing paths. | – | [Source 2](#source2) | | **Quartz Services (macOS only)** | • **Display Services** – direct access to macOS window server for configuring display hardware.
• **Event Services** – manage event taps (filters) for observing/altering low‑level user‑input streams.
• **Window Services** – information about windows managed by the macOS window server. | – | [Source 3](#source3) | | **Additional Enumerations & Structures** | • Various enums and structs for bitmap layout, color models, component info, tone‑mapping, etc. | – | [Source 3](#source3) | ### Take‑away Core Graphics is a comprehensive, low‑level 2‑D graphics API that covers almost every aspect of rendering on Apple platforms—from basic geometry and drawing contexts to advanced PDF handling, color management, and platform‑specific services for macOS. It exposes a rich set of data types, classes, and services that allow developers to build high‑fidelity graphics, PDFs, and custom UI elements with fine‑grained control.
